summary: Extended the leg-(d) calibration driver (within contract) and measured the baseline lane live. Project-switch leg is GREEN/deterministic: addProject dialog -> save (projects 1->2) -> switch flips main-header .current-project-title 'Super Productivity'->'Witness leg-d project'. The formly theme save DOES shift --palette-primary-500 (11,119,210 -> 12,122,212 on body+drawer), but the witness PageHandle has NO fill/evaluate/setInputValue and char-press/arrow keys leave a native input[type=color] unchanged; palette recomputes only on save, so I could NOT confirm the color value was actually driven vs save-side re-quantization. Migrated lane unmeasured; 'no guessed values' forbids pinning. Full scope (both-lane calibrate + schema shape + producer wiring + tests + gate) exceeds this unit. Repo still typechecks.
open_questions: Color proof provenance: the witness PageHandle cannot set a native input[type=color] (no fill/evaluate; keyEvents:false rejected). The measurable --palette-primary-500 shift (11,119,210->12,122,212) appears only after the formly save and may be re-quantization rather than a driven color change. Is a save-produced shift with an undriven color input acceptable as 'a genuine formly config save shifting a measurable style', or must leg-d step 2 instead drive a control the witness CAN operate (theme form's isAutoContrast checkbox or huePrimary mat-select, both click-driveable) after confirming which palette var they shift?

Migrated lane is unmeasured. Per 'measure first on both lanes / no guessed values' I cannot pin values. Need budget to run the migrated-lane calibration and confirm the shift holds AND whether its rgb matches baseline (Angular 8 vs Angular 16 material-css-vars may differ, affecting the behavior-digest lane agreement).

Scope: each calibration run costs ~3 min pre-leg-d before leg-d even starts; both-lane calibration + schema rule-pins + producer wiring + per-idiom tests + whole-repo gate does not fit a 35-min unit. Should leg-d be re-cut (e.g., calibration+finding unit, then schema+producer unit)?
